facts.fact: Mediacongo reports that the digital economy ministry's validation workshop on the draft national AI strategy, closed on 27 July 2026, included the private sector, academia, civil society and technical partners alongside public institutions.

note: Validation workshop names experts and stakeholders only; no one outside government is named in the room, and the strategy is not a named digital law or policy in force.

facts.fact: ACEDH says rural communities, indigenous peoples and defenders were not consulted on the RDC-PASS digital identification project and that public information and citizen participation are lacking.

note: Validation workshop on draft orders names no participant from outside government.
